title: Google\Cloud\AutoMl\V1beta1\TimestampStats
name: TimestampStats
description: The data statistics of a series of TIMESTAMP values.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.granular_stats
params.description: The string key is the pre-defined granularity. Currently supported: hour_of_day, day_of_week, month_of_year. Granularities finer that the granularity of timestamp data are not populated (e.g. if timestamps are at day granularity, then hour_of_day is not populated).

methods.name: getGranularStats
methods.description: The string key is the pre-defined granularity. Currently supported: hour_of_day, day_of_week, month_of_year.

methods.name: setGranularStats
methods.description: The string key is the pre-defined granularity. Currently supported: hour_of_day, day_of_week, month_of_year.
